exampleSentence: The man ___ lives next door is a doctor.
englishDefinition: Use 'who' as the subject of a clause that describes a person.

exampleSentence: I know the girl ___ won the singing contest.
englishDefinition: 'who' refers to a person and acts as the subject of the clause.

exampleSentence: The police caught the man ___ stole the car.
englishDefinition: 'who' introduces a clause that tells us more about a person.

exampleSentence: Students ___ work hard usually do well.
englishDefinition: 'who' is used for people and is the subject of the verb that follows.

exampleSentence: The boy ___ is wearing a red cap is my cousin.
englishDefinition: 'who' refers to a person doing the action in the clause.

exampleSentence: People ___ smoke often get sick more easily.
englishDefinition: 'who' introduces a clause describing people.

exampleSentence: This is the book ___ made me cry.
englishDefinition: Use 'which' for animals or things, not people.

exampleSentence: The house ___ stands on the hill is very old.
englishDefinition: 'which' refers to a thing and is the subject of the clause.

exampleSentence: He showed me the photos ___ he took in Japan.
englishDefinition: 'which' refers to things and can be the object of the clause.

exampleSentence: The movie ___ we saw last night was boring.
englishDefinition: 'which' is used for things; here it is the object of 'saw'.

exampleSentence: The bus ___ goes to the zoo leaves at nine.
englishDefinition: 'which' refers to a thing and is the subject of the clause.

exampleSentence: The cake ___ my mom made was delicious.
englishDefinition: 'which' is used for things; here it is the object of 'made'.

chinese: （關係代名詞）最高級/all/only 之後
exampleSentence: This is the best cake ___ I have ever eaten.
englishDefinition: After a superlative ('the best'), 'that' is the usual relative pronoun.

chinese: （關係代名詞）最高級/all/only 之後
exampleSentence: She is the only friend ___ understands me.
englishDefinition: After 'only', use 'that' to introduce the clause.

exampleSentence: Everything ___ he said last night was true.
englishDefinition: After 'everything/all', 'that' is the standard relative pronoun.

exampleSentence: Is this the key ___ opens the front door?
englishDefinition: 'that' can refer to things and often follows everyday nouns.

exampleSentence: I met a boy ___ father is a famous singer.
englishDefinition: Use 'whose' to show possession ('the boy's father').

exampleSentence: She is the woman ___ car was stolen yesterday.
englishDefinition: 'whose' shows that something belongs to the person.

exampleSentence: That is the student ___ project won first prize.
englishDefinition: 'whose' connects a noun to its owner.

exampleSentence: We helped a family ___ house was destroyed in the flood.
englishDefinition: 'whose' shows possession and is followed by a noun.

exampleSentence: The man to ___ I spoke was very kind.
englishDefinition: After a preposition ('to'), use the object form 'whom'.

exampleSentence: The friends with ___ I traveled are from Canada.
englishDefinition: After a preposition ('with'), use 'whom' for a person.

exampleSentence: She is the teacher about ___ everyone talks.
englishDefinition: After a preposition ('about'), use 'whom' for a person.

exampleSentence: This is the house ___ I was born.
englishDefinition: Use 'where' to describe a place.

exampleSentence: Do you know the restaurant ___ they serve great pizza?
englishDefinition: 'where' introduces a clause about a place.

exampleSentence: That is the city ___ my grandparents live.
englishDefinition: Use 'where' for a place in which something happens.

exampleSentence: He showed me the park ___ we used to play as kids.
englishDefinition: 'where' refers to a location.

exampleSentence: I will never forget the day ___ we first met.
englishDefinition: Use 'when' to describe a time.

exampleSentence: Summer is the season ___ the days are longest.
englishDefinition: 'when' introduces a clause about a time.

exampleSentence: Do you remember the year ___ we moved to Taipei?
englishDefinition: Use 'when' for a point or period of time.

exampleSentence: Winter is the time ___ many people catch colds.
englishDefinition: 'when' refers to a time.

englishDefinition: Use 'why' after 'the reason' to give a cause.

exampleSentence: That is the reason ___ she left the party early.
englishDefinition: 'why' follows 'the reason' to explain a cause.

englishDefinition: 'what' means 'the thing that' and has no separate noun before it.
